applied_fields.title: An infinite family of Pythagorean triples
applied_fields.description: For all natural a and b, these three polynomial expressions satisfy the Pythagorean equation. Hybrid v5 found a 17-step proof by preserving repeated expressions and proving smaller algebraic obligations; the unchanged native kernel checked all 56,356 proof nodes. Zero and degenerate triples are included. This does not assert primitivity or classify every triple. The winning steps are native heuristics; neither adviser was needed.
